title: What Is Really Clogging Your Drain?
description: Ever wondered why your sink drains slower than usual? Most sink blockages happen gradually from everyday habits. In the kitchen, cooking grease, food scraps, and coffee grounds cling to pipe walls, hardening over time. In the bathroom, a combination of soap scum, hair, and toothpaste buildup is usually the culprit. Pouring fats down the drain can quickly restrict water flow and cause backups. While minor slow drains can sometimes be cleared with a simple plunger, stubborn or recurring blockages require a professional inspection to prevent long-term pipe damage. Keeping an eye on what goes down your drain is the easiest way to avoid plumbing emergencies.
